sql_insights.name: Observed MCP tool quality · noncanonical
sql_insights.description: Prepared · Awaiting deployed native MCP events. Covers reviewed scoped gateway calls while a consented renderer is active; includes permission/validation rejections. Noncanonical operational measure; no traffic does not imply health. Every tool with a rejection appears, plus tools with at least 20 calls.

query.query:
SELECT
    coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.$mcp_exec_tool_call_name), ''), toString(properties.$mcp_tool_name)) AS tool,
    count() AS calls,
    countIf(toBool(properties.$mcp_is_error)) AS rejected_calls,
    round(countIf(toBool(properties.$mcp_is_error)) * 100.0 / count(), 1) AS rejected_pct,
    quantile(0.50)(toFloat(properties.$mcp_duration_ms)) AS p50_ms,
    quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.$mcp_duration_ms)) AS p95_ms
FROM events
WHERE event = '$mcp_tool_call'
    AND properties.$mcp_server_name = 'pitchcrew'
    AND properties.mcp_observation_level = 'scoped_gateway'
    AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY tool
HAVING calls >= 20 OR rejected_calls > 0
ORDER BY rejected_pct DESC, calls DESC
LIMIT 50
